content: coffee A controlled blast on a movie set near London’s O2 arena ignited a fire that ruined a van and harmed a car and a lorry. Firefighters were dispatched to an open‑air yard on Dock Road in Silvertown just before 8 p.m. on Saturday, and after about an hour the flames were contained with roughly two dozen crews on scene and no injuries reported. The incident is said to have stemmed from a pre‑arranged filming activity at the venue, which also schedules shows by Niall Horan and Texas in the coming days. The London Fire Brigade updated on X that the fire in Silvertown is now under control, noting the destroyed van, the damaged car and lorry, and confirming no injuries. They added that the blaze originated from a controlled explosion on the set that escaped containment, that firefighters acted swiftly to put it out, and that personnel will stay until the evening ends. The yard lies close to the Thames cable‑car route, and a Metropolitan Police spokesman said they are aware of reports of explosions heard near the O2 in Greenwich.
